note: Parameters read BY EYE from the registered body (colour bands per row) on 2026-09-25; derive_r2.py applies them.

split_body.why: the belt's grey rows start at y 797-845 and end by 899 (measured grey-row profile); everything above y 800 is torso; the coat hem outline (within 12 px of red) is drawn over the trousers and stays with the coat; legs are the navy/boot regions below

helmet_front.why: helmet_front r2 is cut from the MASTER's pixels (no seam at rest). zone_px: search band around the registered helmet; palette_margin: a pixel is head only when its colour is nearer the head palette by this much (shell shading stays helmet); ink_px: outline within this distance of helmet colour is helmet; fill_reach_px: master pixels next to the helmet that head_no_helmet does not cover are kept so the stack has no hole

raised_arms.why: r1 raised arms touched the canvas edge (86 rows at x 0, 15 at x 1023): each raised arm is rotated about its recorded shoulder pivot by the smallest angle that keeps 4 px of margin

edge_to_master.why: r2.1 (verifier: arm_left's shoulder cap and outer sleeve bulged out of the master silhouette on the image-right side, x 762 vs 724 at y 560, 7784 px outside): the far arm keeps its drawing, but what shows at rest outside the master's silhouette is trimmed and the new edge takes the master's own outline pixels (band_px); the body's shoulder that the old bulge hid is fitted the same way. Hidden overlap under the layers in front is kept for rotation

head_blank_adjust.why: r2.1 (verifier: the r1 fit, score 0.538, put the chin and jowls 12-27 px below head_no_helmet and 4563 px outside it): a similarity correction on top of the r1 fit, about the blank's nostril midpoint, found by a grid search that matches the nostrils and the jaw/chin/neck outline (below the snout) to the registered head_no_helmet: scale 1.005, dx -4, dy -17. The chin at x 500 lands on y 581 (head 582), the nostrils coincide within 2 px, 1474 px outside head_no_helmet (was 4563); overlay reviewed. The crown stays lumpy and the right jowl a little narrower: the blank head is its own drawing

shield_13.why: r2.1: the Station 13 shield, lettered locally from the r2 shield_plate with tools/art/letter_shield.py (ART_HERO.md shield rule; the r2 file was lettered from the r1 plate and no longer matched it). Contract v1.3: the mascot rig carries no lettering, so the rig uses the blank shield_plate and the runtime letters it; shield_13 serves the static uses (reel W, thumbnail) and its place in the rig delivery is the coordinator's call
